hooks.command: file=$(echo '$TOOL_INPUT' | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$file" == *".env"* && "$file" != *".env.example"* ]]; then echo 'BLOCKED: direct .env edit is not allowed. Use .env.example and set values manually.'; exit 1; fi
file=$(echo '$TOOL_INPUT' | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$file" == *"pnpm-lock.yaml"* ]]; then echo 'BLOCKED: do not edit pnpm-lock.yaml manually. Run pnpm install instead.'; exit 1; fi
